researcher.description: Fast lookups: where does X happen, how does library Y work. Use before planning a change.

planner.description: Produces implementation plans with strategy, trade-offs and risks before code changes.

implementer.description: Executes low-to-medium complexity steps of a written plan once the strategy is settled.

implementer-hard.description: Executes medium-to-hard steps of a written plan (domain logic, schemas, importers).

implementer-complex.description: Executes really long or complex steps of an agreed plan (auth, schema, architecture).

reviewer.description: Reviews a diff or change set for correctness, security and project conventions before merge.

reviewer-complex.description: High-complexity reviewer. Reviews security-critical, architectural, schema/migration or concurrency changes, and the final whole-branch review of a PR, for correctness, security and project conventions. Use only where the default reviewer is not enough.
